name: Teacup Tidy
description: Eight cups, six teas. Pour the top layers between cups until every cup holds a single tea. Colours also differ by pattern and letter. A puzzle each day, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eight cups stand on a shelf. Six hold four layers of tea each, mixed up, and two are empty. Pour tea from cup to cup to sort it.
help.goal: Make every cup hold one tea only: four layers of the same tea, or nothing at all. There is no timer, and fewer moves is only a bonus.
howToPlay: Pick up a cup, then choose the cup to pour into. Only the top run of one tea moves, and only as much as fits.
You can pour onto an empty cup, or onto a cup whose top layer is the same tea.
Each tea has its own colour, pattern and first letter, so you never need to rely on colour alone.
Undo has no limit. Restart tangles the same puzzle again. Today's puzzle is the same for everyone today and remembers your best. New puzzle deals a fresh one.

controls.action: Pick up a cup, then pour into another cup
Reach Undo, Restart and the puzzle buttons

tips: Keep an empty cup free as long as you can.
Uncover a buried layer first, then pour a matching tea onto it.
If you get stuck, Undo as far back as you like, or Restart.
You can stop at any time. Your puzzle is saved and waits for you.
